title: Wolfenstein 3 is officially happening #gaming #shorts
description: Xbox announced a new Wolfenstein game from MachineGames, the studio behind Wolfenstein II. Source: Techloy Brief.

scenes.say: Xbox just announced a brand new Wolfenstein game.
It's coming from MachineGames, the same studio behind Wolfenstein two.
Fans have been begging for this sequel for years.
So be honest. Are you hyped for it, or nah?
